## Catalog

- **Catalog URL:**
- **Listing file:** `catalogs/<slug>.json`

## Checklist

- [ ] My catalog is publicly reachable over HTTPS without authentication.
- [ ] `ai-catalog validate` reports no errors for my catalog.
- [ ] My catalog has at least one entry and isn't already listed (directly or as a nested catalog).
- [ ] I only added or changed files in `catalogs/` (the README list is regenerated automatically).
- [ ] If I set `identifier`, I'm the publisher and its `urn:air` domain matches my catalog URL.
